visual_connections.description: Users connect to the public gateway EC2 instance.
Public gateway EC2 authenticates via Active Directory.
EMR reads and processes data stored in S3.
KMS provides encryption keys for RDS.
KMS provides encryption keys to secure data in S3.
Sandbox EC2 instance accesses data stored in S3.
